    (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) : mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec recv ⊢
    mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec recv ∗ mvcc.api.logTok ι l dec

    lo L c0 cov dead).fgs → dec x = dec' x) : mvcc.api.sent.sendFact dec r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead =
    mvcc.api.sent.sendFact dec' r fg rg lo L c0 cov dead

theorem mvcc.api.chanApiAt_close (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (lm : List

    ⌜(mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S = S ∧ ∀ (d : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)),
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay d (l ++ [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.close])).S = (mvcc.api.sent.replay d
    lm).S.close⌝

def mvcc.api.cancelTok (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l rg fg lo, monoListLbOwn ι.ev (l ++ [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.cancel id]) ∗ ⌜mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo ∈ l⌝)

theorem mvcc.api.LogWF_congr (dec dec' : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (l : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (h : ∀ (x : GName), x ∈ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf l → dec x = dec' x) (hwf :
    mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l) : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec' l

theorem mvcc.api.chanApiAt_regTok (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg :
    GName) (lo : Nat) (hm : mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo ∈ l) : mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec recv
    ⊢ mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec recv ∗ mvcc.api.regTok ι id rg fg lo

def mvcc.api.chanApiAt (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName → List
    (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn ι.ev 1 l ∗
      ⌜mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec l ∧ recv <+: mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l⌝ ∗
        ([∗list] fg ∈ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf l, mvcc.api.savedFilters fg (dec fg)) ∗
          ([∗list] e ∈ l, mvcc.api.evTok ι.st e) ∗
            ghostVar ι.rcv (Qp.half 1) recv ∗ monoNatLbOwn ι.ns (mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l))

theorem mvcc.api.chanApiAt_reg (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName → List
    (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (lm : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg : GName) (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool))
    (lo : Nat) (hnone : S.ws !! id = none) (hneg : id ≠ W64 (-1)) : ⊢ mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec
    recv ∗ mvcc.api.wsStateI ι S ∗ ghostVar ι.cl (Qp.half 1) lm ∗ mvcc.api.savedFilters fg fs ==∗ ∃
    dec', mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι (l ++ [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo]) dec' recv ∗
    mvcc.api.wsStateI ι (S.register id { rg := rg, fs := fs, lo := lo, k := (mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf
    l).length, live := true }) ∗ ghostVar ι.cl (Qp.half 1) (l ++ [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg
    lo]) ∗ ⌜∀ (d : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)), (mvcc.api.sent.replay d (l ++
    [mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo])).S = (mvcc.api.sent.replay d lm).S.register id { rg := rg,
    fs := d fg, lo := lo, k := (mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l).length, live := true }⌝ ∗
    mvcc.api.wsSentLbI ι (mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l).length

theorem mvcc.api.sepL_congr {A : Type} (Φ Ψ : A → IProp GF) (l : List A) : (∀ (x : A), x ∈ l → Φ x =
    Ψ x) → ([∗list] x ∈ l, Φ x) ⊢ [∗list] x ∈ l, Ψ x

def mvcc.api.regTok (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (id : w64) (rg : mvcc.WatchRange) (fg : GName) (lo : Nat) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l, monoListLbOwn ι.ev l ∗ ⌜mvcc.api.sent.SEv.reg id rg fg lo ∈ l⌝)

theorem mvcc.api.chanApiAt_wsState (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (lm : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) : mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec recv ∗ mvcc.api.wsStateI ι S ∗ ghostVar ι.cl
    (Qp.half 1) lm ⊢ mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec recv ∗ monoNatAuthOwn ι.ns 1 (mvcc.api.sent.nsCount
    l) ∗ ghostVar ι.cl (Qp.half 1) lm ∗ ghostVar ι.cl (Qp.half 1) lm ∗ ⌜(mvcc.api.sent.replay dec
    l).S = S ∧ ∀ (d : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)), (mvcc.api.sent.replay d l).S =
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay d lm).S⌝

    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (hns :

theorem mvcc.api.chanApi_alloc (st : mvcc.api.AbsNames) (ch : GoChan) (chn : ChanNames) (gcr :

    dec l).D⌝

theorem mvcc.api.chanApiAt_plain (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) (S : mvcc.api.StreamState) (lm : List
    mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (hns : mvcc.api.sent.nsCount [e] = 1) (hfg : e.fgs =
    []) (hev : mvcc.api.evTok ι.st e = iprop(True)) (hok : mvcc.api.sent.stepOk dec
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l) e) : ⊢ mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι l dec recv ∗ mvcc.api.wsStateI ι S ∗
    ghostVar ι.cl (Qp.half 1) lm ==∗ mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι (l ++ [e]) dec recv ∗ mvcc.api.wsStateI ι
    (mvcc.api.sent.RState.step dec (mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l) e).S ∗ ghostVar ι.cl (Qp.half 1) (l
    ++ [e]) ∗ ⌜(mvcc.api.sent.replay dec l).S = S ∧ ∀ (d : GName → List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)),
    (mvcc.api.sent.replay d l).S = (mvcc.api.sent.replay d lm).S⌝

theorem mvcc.api.chanApiAt_client (ι : mvcc.api.WsAbs) (l : List mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (dec : GName →
    List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (recv : List mvcc.api.WResp) (e : mvcc.api.sent.SEv) (hns :
    mvcc.api.sent.nsCount [e] = 1) (hwf : mvcc.api.sent.LogWF dec (l ++ [e])) (hrcv : recv <+:
    mvcc.api.sent.sendsOf l) : ⊢ (monoListAuthOwn ι.ev 1 l ∗ monoNatAuthOwn ι.ns 1
    (mvcc.api.sent.nsCount l) ∗ ghostVar ι.rcv (Qp.half 1) recv ∗ ([∗list] fg ∈ mvcc.api.sent.fgsOf
    (l ++ [e]), mvcc.api.savedFilters fg (dec fg)) ∗ [∗list] e' ∈ l ++ [e], mvcc.api.evTok ι.st e')
    ==∗ mvcc.api.chanApiAt ι (l ++ [e]) dec recv ∗ monoNatAuthOwn ι.ns 1 (mvcc.api.sent.nsCount (l
    ++ [e])) ∗ mvcc.api.logTok ι (l ++ [e]) dec
